اقتعدتم (form VIII)
# اِقْتَعَدْتُمْ (iqtaʕadtum) /iq.ta.ʕad.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# اُقْتُعِدْتُمْ (uqtuʕidtum) /uq.tu.ʕid.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
